name: Marché KM5 (PK5)
subtitle: Bangui's vibrant economic lung and historic multicultural marketplace in the 3rd arrondissement.

facts.label: Role
facts.value: Primary wholesale and retail trading hub of the Central African capital

facts.label: Goods
facts.value: Hardware, textiles, regional cassava, smoked fish, and cattle from regional trade routes

parts.text: The primary commercial and financial heartbeat of Bangui, located in the 3rd arrondissement approximately five kilometers west of the administrative center. Known as KM5 or PK5, it is a bustling network of open avenues, stalls, and storehouses where long-distance wholesale traders from Chad, Cameroon, and the provinces connect with local retailers, supplying the city with fabrics, grain, imported electronics, meat, and artisanal hardware.

gaps: Precise data on post-reconstruction trading associations and volume of trans-border flows are limited.
